S.1, Special Branch XXXXXX
REPORT
Date November 17, 19 39.
Subject T. H. Lee.
Made by D.P.S. Killingbeck Forwarded by ?
With reference to the attached communication
regarding Lee Tien Hua, enquiries into the movements
of this person were conducted by D.S.I. Kao and D.P.S.
Killingbeck, also D.I. Hutton, Louza.
A routine search of all rooms on the fifth
floor of the Oriental Hotel was carried out, under the
instructions of D.I. Hutton. Room 503 was included
in the search, but the search was carried on in a manner
that would leave no grounds to suspect that the room
was of any particular interest to the search party.
Further discreet enquiries were conducted by
D.S.I. Kao, and the following information obtained :-
Lee Tien-hua (李天化) is aged 38, married
and is a native of Hongkong. He arrived in Shanghai
on November 14 from Hongkong, accompanied by his wife
and engaged Room 503 at the Oriental Hotel. It is
not known how long he intends to remain in Shanghai,
but it is understood that he is in Shanghai for the
purpose of purchasing goods. He is visited during the
day by various brokers and, amongst his personal effects,
various samples of paper, from Shanghai firms, were found.
A card is attached to this report, showing
that Lee conducts a business at 16 Pottinger Street,
Hongkong, and papers found in his bags support the view
that Lee is a bona-fide business man, engaged in the
paper trade. Business correspondence from Clive and
Co., 21 Godhman Street, London, E.C. 4, and invoices

档案编号 9557/0
S.1，特别股 XXXXXX
报告
日期：1939年11月17日。
主题：T. H. Lee（李天华）。
制作人：副督察基林贝克（Killingbeck） 转呈人：？
关于所附有关李天华（Lee Tien Hua）的函件，副督察高（Kao）、副督察基林贝克（Killingbeck）以及督察赫顿（Hutton）、鲁扎（Louza）对该人的行踪进行了调查。
根据督察赫顿的指示，对东方饭店（Oriental Hotel）五楼的所有房间进行了例行搜查。503号房间也在搜查范围内，但搜查方式刻意避免引起怀疑，未显露出该房间是搜查组的特定关注对象。
副督察高随后进行了进一步的秘密调查，并获得如下信息：
李天化（Lee Tien-hua），现年38岁，已婚，香港籍。他于11月14日由香港抵达上海，由其妻子陪同，并在东方饭店入住503号房间。目前尚不清楚他打算在上海停留多久，但据悉他来沪目的是采购货物。白天有各类掮客拜访他，在其个人物品中发现了来自上海各商行的各种纸张样品。
本报告附有一张名片，显示李在香港宝灵街（Pottinger Street）16号经营生意，其手提箱中发现的文件也佐证了李是一名从事纸张贸易的正当商人。此外，在其物品中还发现了来自伦敦E.C.4区戈德曼街（Godhman Street）21号克莱夫公司（Clive and Co.）的商业信函，以及汉堡一家纸行开具的发票
